description:
Generates Sequence Similarity Networks
    
Build a sequence similarity network and do analysis related to that.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.help: pairwise similarity (or distance) scores. In the network, nodes will be derived from row and column names, and edges will be added between pairs of rows and columns meeting the threshold criteria. Format can be tab-separated text, or Domainator hdf5.

parameters.name: Lb
parameters.help: exclude all edges with weights less than or equal to this value. This should be >= 0.

parameters.name: Metadata
parameters.help: tab separated files of sequence metadata.

parameters.name: Subset
parameters.help: Only consider matrix labels in this list. Additive with --subset_file.

parameters.name: Subset File
parameters.help: text file containing matrix labels to retain.

parameters.name: Color By
parameters.help: Color the points in the output image based on this column of the metadata table.

parameters.name: Color Table
parameters.help: tab separated file with two columns and no header, columns are: annotation, hex color. For example: CCDB   cc0000

parameters.name: Xgmml
parameters.help: write a cytoscape xgmml file of the projection.

parameters.name: Cluster
parameters.help: Creates a new metadata column called 'SSN_cluster', replacing that column from the metadata file if already present. Finds clusters by following connectivity, assigns each cluster a distinct integer, based on size rank, bigger clusters get smaller numbers.

advanced_parameters.name: Max Color Groups
advanced_parameters.help: Give distinct colors only to this many of the largest Color By groups, all remaining groups share a neutral gray. By default every group gets a color, cycling over a palette of 64 distinguishable colors.

advanced_parameters.name: Mark Mst
advanced_parameters.help: Give every edge a boolean 'MST' property saying whether it belongs to the maximum spanning tree. Useful for styling or filtering the MST backbone within a larger network in Cytoscape.

advanced_parameters.name: Color Table Out
advanced_parameters.help: tab separated file with two columns and no header, columns are: annotation, hex color. Written after the color table is updated with new colors, for example if using --color_by, but not supplying an external color table.

advanced_parameters.name: Cluster Tsv
advanced_parameters.help: Path to write a tsv file will mapping each sequence to its cluster. If set, then --cluster is automatically activated. If --no_cluster_header not set, then the file will have header contig cluster.

advanced_parameters.name: No Cluster Header
advanced_parameters.help: If set, then the tsv file will not have a header. Only relevant if --cluster_tsv is set.

advanced_parameters.name: Mst
advanced_parameters.help: If set, then only include edges that are part of the maximum spanning tree of the graph. The clusters will be the same as the full graph, but the intra-cluster connections will be pruned to the minimum necessary to preserve the clusters. Mutually exclusive with Mst KNN.

advanced_parameters.name: KNN
advanced_parameters.help: Include OR-symmetric k-nearest-neighbor edges (K at least 1). On its own this can split a cluster of the full graph into several clusters; combine with Mst to keep the graph's connectivity. Mutually exclusive with Mst KNN.

advanced_parameters.name: Mst KNN
advanced_parameters.help: Include the maximum spanning tree plus OR-symmetric k-nearest-neighbor edges. Equivalent to Mst plus KNN. K must be at least 0; K=0 gives just the maximum spanning tree. Mutually exclusive with Mst and KNN.

advanced_parameters.name: Max Output Gb
advanced_parameters.help: Fail if a projected output file would exceed this many GB. Set to 0 to disable the guardrail.
